newsitem.title: SPAIN: Retevision to build second network within a year.
newsitem.headline: Retevision to build second network within a year.

text.p: Retevision chairman Pedro de Torres said on Wednesday the telecommunications company would build a second network within the next year to ensure competition in the market.
Retevision, which will become Spain's second domestic telephone operator, will start by using Telefonica's existing network, paying an average interconnection charge of 5.1 pesetas per minute.
The choice of partners will be vital to contribute to finance and extend the already existing network and provide the necessary technology, De Torres said.
Retevision has accepted three bids for the state's sale of 60 percent of the company. The groups must present a final list of their participants by May 12 and their bids by June 9.

The three groups accepted so far are: Deutsche Telecom, France Telecom, Sprint Corp and Banco Central Hispano ; Stet International, Endesa, Union Fenosa, Basque group Eusakaltel and several Basque banks; and Mannesmann with AT&T.
